name: gemini-quality-gate-jev
description: TypeSafe Jev gates for Gemini CLI: one correction pass after each answer, a risk guard before tool calls, a policy check before each request, and a session pre-flight advisory.

settings.name: TypeSafe API key
settings.description: API key used to call TypeSafe Jev. Optional: the hooks also read ${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-~/.config}/typesafe/jev.env, which install.sh writes.
